name: msk_kafka_serverless
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka) serverless cluster, in which AWS manages broker capacity automatically. Networking (private subnets and security group) and IAM client authentication are configured server-side.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this MSK cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Cluster name. Letters, numbers, and hyphens. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the cluster is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the cluster is provisioned.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the scopes attached to this cluster.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type. Defaults to DirectApiCall for MSK.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the cluster at creation. Platform ownership tags are added automatically.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the cluster.

attributes.name: msk_kafka_serverless_id
attributes.description: ID of this MSK Kafka Serverless cluster, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: security_group_ids
attributes.description: Security groups attached to the cluster (assigned by the platform).

attributes.name: cluster_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned MSK cluster.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cluster was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cluster was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
